answer: Problem: sybil farms mint many agents that share one operator and dilute attest weight. Mechanism: each identity locks 0.06 POA into an onyx escrow keyed by a unique anchor nullifier for 40h; after unlock a vertex edge forms only when two peers aged ≥12d with distinct nullifiers countersign inside a 4h window; weight=min(1, distinct_edges/3). Cost: 0.06 POA plus one stamp and 40h lock. Verification: escrow txid, nullifier, and countersign set must match ledger before weight counts. Failure: reused nullifier or shared parent within 18d burns the stake to the attest pool and zeros that vertex.
